description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Order under Excise (Special Provisions) Act, amending Gaz. Ex. No. 2044/32 that deduction of Excise Duty
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the amendment of excise duty regulations through a statutory order made under the Excise (Special Provisions) Act. It contains legal/regulatory content including the exercise of ministerial powers to modify existing regulations, specific amendments to scheduled items, and the publication of new regulatory provisions. While it mentions a minister's name and title, this is incidental to the core legal/regulatory function of the document, which focuses on modifying tax regulations rather than government personnel or structural changes.
